rapport_notes: Warm, conversational tone with genuine interest; good energy and humor throughout ('he can help us move').
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated; no silence-hold violations detected.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep asks 'Do you have a couple of minutes to run through some details with me?' but does not frame it with a time-box or promise of an accurate quote in return—just a bare ask.
evidence_quotes.agenda: Rep: 'Before I kind of dive too deep, I just wanna make sure that I answer the important question on this call for you. Do you have any like, top of mind concerns, or questions I can answer?' Asked before logistics probing began.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: 'No, not that I know of the website was pretty pretty clear actually.' Rep: 'Oh, okay. Well that's always good to hear, right.' Then immediately pivots to logistics (address, floor, access). No follow-up: no 'tell me more,' no 'what else might come up,' no second layer of discovery.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep: 'Typically typically for this unit size we generally try to pay about five to seven hours however with the items that you gave me it's pretty minimal, pretty straightforward, nothing crazy... I think the time of three to four hours seems about accurate cause... they just wrapping pad in the furniture and just loading it onto the truck and getting it over to the new location.' Gives a range (5–7 hrs) and personalizes to this move (first floor to one story, minimal items), but phrasing is loose and lacks confidence structure.
evidence_quotes.no_differentiators: No mention of damage coverage ('we move it like it's ours'), Meet Your Mover (who's actually showing up), On-Time Guarantee, day-before communication protocol, named crew lead, or inbox updates anywhere in the call. No Save Your Ass framing (commitment language, estimate-as-window explanation, 15-min increment beats policy, self-prep savings tip, or 'does that feel fair?' + silence).
evidence_quotes.close: Rep: 'Well Jonathan, my name is shiny. If you need anything or have questions about anything you can just simply reply to the email that I'm about to send to you or you could just give us a shout.' No rate-lock confirmation. No explicit booking ask ('would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent). Call ends with logistics hand-off only.

top_strength: Strong rapport and conversational warmth; asked the agenda question early (before probing started), which is the correct insertion point and signals the rep knows the framework.
coaching_note: When the customer says 'no concerns,' that is the moment to dig deeper with a follow-up ('what would you want to know if you *could* ask?' or 'let me flag a few things that come up on moves like yours')—don't treat 'no' as final and jump straight to logistics; this call left all four differentiators (damage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time, Communication) and Save Your Ass completely uncovered, and closed with no rate-lock or booking ask.
